about: Places in the game's code that make shaders (a node material, a compute pass) the smoke does not build, by file and function, with how many places in each (tools/smoke.js unbuilt, tools/sites.js), and why. The gate never compiles them (tools/gate/wgsl.js). The smoke fails on one not here; each here is to be made by the smoke and taken out. 2026-11-19: the canopy's passes were found so, and made; then everything the start and the library make, the stress stand and the WebGL 2 fallback.
